scenarios.desc: Title check FAIL blocks even when the validator exit code is 0
scenarios.input:
Act as the QA agent in pre-PR validation. All other gates and coverage already passed (line 85%, branch 75%, new-code 88%). Decide the verdict for the PR Description gate. validate_pr_description.py exited 0. Per-check results: Conventional Commit Title FAIL, Issue Keywords Present PASS, Template Compliance PASS.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: a FAIL title check is a gate FAIL; ignore the exit code and read each check.

scenarios.rationale: Changed branch: keyword and template checks are PASS or WARN; only the title check FAILs the gate.

scenarios.desc: Regression: coverage below the block threshold still blocks
scenarios.input:
Act as the QA agent in pre-PR validation. All other gates and coverage already passed (line 85%, branch 75%, new-code 88%). Decide the verdict for the PR Description gate. validate_pr_description.py exited 0 with all three checks PASS. Line coverage is 65 percent, below the 70 percent block threshold.
Keep the reason under 15 words and do not quote the inputs.
scenarios.rationale: Regression: coverage thresholds still block independent of the PR description gate.
